title: Giving Up Places on a Vacation Package
content:
Only the party may cancel their own package, and the cancellation is confirmed by the lead traveller rather than performed on their behalf. This note records the terms the vacation packages desk applies when places on one of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products are given up.

## What the desk must have from the party

The party states in this conversation which members of the travelling party are giving up their places. That statement comes from the lead traveller and is taken as it is given; the package record shows how many adults and children are recorded as travelling, but it does not say which of them are giving up their places.

## Clauses no longer in force

Four clauses of this note have been superseded by the current basis of the vacation packages charter and are **no longer in force**. They are recorded here so that the withdrawn wording can be recognised, and none of them is applied:

- "The penalty is read off the product's cancellation ladder by how many whole days lie between the cancellation and the departure date";
- "applied to the package price of the places being given up";
- "The deposit is returned only on a product whose deposit is refundable, and on every other product it is forfeited in full even where the ladder would otherwise return more.";
- "The product's administration charge is withheld per traveller on every cancellation whatever the ladder says".

## Clauses in force

The agency service fee is never returned.

Where some but not all of the party give up their places, the ladder is applied to those places alone and the travellers who remain are re-priced at the occupancy they are left with.

A cancellation made because a surcharge exceeded the product's threshold is free of penalty, and so is a cancellation made because the operator itself changed the itinerary significantly.

## Points of judgement

A party of four of whom two give up their places has given up two places, and the two who remain are re-priced at the occupancy they are left with. A party of four of whom all four give up their places has given up the whole package. In both cases it is the lead traveller who says which places are given up, and in both cases the agency service fee stays with the operator.
